title: MITIN DEV
brief: Russian-language client + owner mobile app prototype. Fictional data only. Client journey: interest, Lead, scripted AI brief, review, agreement, development, demo, launch, support. Both roles share one future MITIN DEV API / FastAPI backend and CRM; never create a second CRM. Prototype only: no API, credentials, accounts, notifications, payments, migrations or deployment. Role selection exists only on the developer/demo screen. Production role comes from backend authorization. Preserve budget_range. Use real stages, not invented progress percentages. Use local mock repositories for Android implementation; production integration requires a separate task.

frames.name: DEMO · роли
frames.note: Developer/demo-only entry. Role is not user-selectable in the production application. All names, projects, contacts and prices are fictional fixtures. Preview state resets when closed or reloaded.

frames.name: CLIENT 01 · Добро пожаловать
frames.note: Client priority. Create project starts a Lead before a contract. Sign in uses a demo entry, no credentials and no account creation.

frames.name: CLIENT · Демо-вход
frames.note: Mock login only. Real app will obtain role from the authenticated backend. Do not add password or phone collection in this prototype.

frames.name: CLIENT 02 · Тип проекта
frames.note: Choose project_type and continue to scripted AI brief. Budget keys must match existing Lead.budget_range; do not invent a second budget taxonomy.

frames.name: CLIENT 03a · AI-бриф
frames.note: Scripted AI, no model requests. User enters a fictional business task. The response is carried into review and the owner Lead card.

frames.name: CLIENT 03b · Функции и бюджет
frames.note: Scripted second AI step. Functional scope, business goal, budget_range, deadline and integrations are carried to review. Estimates are not agreed prices.

frames.name: CLIENT 04 · Проверка заявки

frames.name: CLIENT · Заявка принята
frames.note: Demo-only accepted Lead #1045. A Lead is not automatically a signed project. The next button deliberately moves the reviewer to the existing signed-project fixture p001.

frames.name: CLIENT 05 · Главная

frames.name: CLIENT 06 · Мой проект

frames.name: CLIENT 07 · Этап проекта
frames.note: Development stage detail. Completed tasks, current work, client dependency and next action. Stage state follows the same stage_2 binding as owner.

frames.name: CLIENT 08 · Демо
frames.note: Demo link opens an internal illustrative screen, never an external production site. Approve and feedback affect only local Preview data shared with owner.

frames.name: CLIENT · Макет демо
frames.note: Internal fictional demo destination. No external site or production URL is opened. This frame is only an illustration of the linked demo action.

frames.name: CLIENT · Правки к демо
frames.note: Editable comment kept only in Preview memory. Sending updates the shared demo_feedback binding; no message or notification leaves this browser.

frames.name: CLIENT · Решение по демо
frames.note: Local confirmation only. Owner reads the same demo_status and demo_feedback keys.

frames.name: CLIENT 09 · Материалы
frames.note: Only fixture metadata; no file input, file reading or upload. The add action marks a mock material as attached, shared with owner.

frames.name: CLIENT · Добавление материалов

frames.name: CLIENT 10 · Стоимость
frames.note: Fictional financial breakdown. Development, paid, remainder, third-party annual charges, infrastructure monthly charges and paid APIs stay separate. No checkout or payment actions.

frames.name: CLIENT 11 · Сообщения

frames.name: CLIENT 12 · Поддержка
frames.note: Separate post-launch scenario for p001, demonstrating its future lifecycle; the current development fixture is not silently changed. Production badge is demo status, not a health check. Support is fictional until 30.09.2026.
